_description: Gold triage-evaluation set for the DETERMINISTIC (no-LLM) pipeline. Each vignette carries a gold acuity code and a must_escalate flag. must_escalate cases are unambiguous red-flags that the deterministic safety-override MUST catch (red-flag recall == 1.0). `severe_ok` lets a red-flag vignette match any severe-tier acuity (P1/P2), since the exact P1-vs-P2 split is a clinical judgement the safety layer may make either way.

Sudden confusion and weakness on one side of the body.
